metadata.name: Trackie
metadata.description: Trackie is a New Zealand Actual Budget server image. Sign-in is OpenID Connect, and optional per-user Akahu bank tokens are encrypted at rest.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: ACTUAL_LOGIN_METHOD
environment_variables.description: Login method. Trackie self-host uses OpenID Connect.

environment_variables.name: ACTUAL_OPENID_ENFORCE
environment_variables.description: Require the identity provider and disable password login.

environment_variables.name: ACTUAL_USER_CREATION_MODE
environment_variables.description: Auto-provision a user on the first successful identity-provider login.

environment_variables.name: ACTUAL_OPENID_DISCOVERY_URL
environment_variables.description: OIDC discovery URL. The provider must return a verified email claim.

environment_variables.name: ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_ID
environment_variables.description: OIDC client id. Register callback SERVER_HOSTNAME/openid/callback.

environment_variables.name: ACTUAL_OPENID_SERVER_HOSTNAME
environment_variables.description: Public URL of this server. Official compose uses port 5006. This listing publishes 20005 because 5006 is already used.

environment_variables.name: ACTUAL_IDENTITY_SECRET
environment_variables.description: HMAC key that derives stored user identity from verified email. Do not rotate it.

environment_variables.name: ACTUAL_AKAHU_TOKEN_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Key that encrypts optional per-user Akahu tokens. Rotating it only forces users to paste tokens again.

environment_variables.name: TZ
environment_variables.description: Server timezone used to bucket transaction dates.

ports.description: Web UI. Official host port 5006 is already published by actual-server, so this listing uses 20005.

before_install.en_us: Set ACTUAL_OPENID_DISCOVERY_URL, ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_ID, and ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET before startup. Those are literals in the install form. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables. Register the callback at ACTUAL_OPENID_SERVER_HOSTNAME/openid/callback. Replace ACTUAL_IDENTITY_SECRET and ACTUAL_AKAHU_TOKEN_SECRET before creating data, then do not rotate them. The shipped values are public.
